simple.meaning: a (female) calf , especially one nearly grown (i.e. a heifer )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֶגְלָה (H5697) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

definitions.short: a (female) calf , especially one nearly grown (i.e. a heifer )
definitions.full: H5697. eglah I. עֶגְלָה noun feminine heifer ; — absolute ׳ע Gen 15:9 +; construct עֶגְלַת Isa 7:21 +; suffix עֶגְלָתִי Judg 14:18 ; plural construct עֶגְלוֺת Hosea 10:5 (but see below); — heifer , Isa 7:21 , used in ploughing Judg 14:18 (figurative), threshing Jer 50:11 ( ׳ע דָשָׁא , in simile, see דּוּשׁ , read perhaps דָשָׁה ), figurative of stateliness etc. 46:20 ; ׳ע מְלֻמָּדָה Hosea 10:11 a trained heifer (simile of Ephraim); used for sacrifice 1Sam 16:2 ( בָּקָר עֶגְלַת ); cut in two for ratifying covenant Gen 15:9 (J; ׳ע מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת ; compare עֵגֶל Jer 34:18-19 ,); in cleansing city from blood-guiltiness Deut 21:3 ( ׳ע בָּקָר ), 21:4 ; 21:4 ; 21:6 ; once of calves worshipped in Northern Israel Hosea 10:5 (where read probably עֵגֶל , so ᵐ5 We Now GASm, compare Che, see also the following suffixes masculine singular). עֶגְלַת proper name, of a location ; — ׳ע שְׁלִשִׁיָּה (the) third, Eglath Isa 15:5 ( ᵐ5 δάμαλις τριερής ) Jer 48:34 ( ᵐ5 ἀγγελιαν Σαλασεια ), near Zoar and southern border of Moab.
